papers.title: Type I IFN promotes ILC2-to-ILC1 plasticity in pre-clinical radiation-induced lung injury.
papers.authors: Kim J, Li H, Mannan R, Doherty TA, McGee HM.
papers.abstract: Radiation-induced lung injury (RILI) is a common dose-limiting toxicity after radiotherapy for lung cancer, but the immunological mechanisms contributing to RILI pathogenesis remain poorly understood. Here we analyze a RILI mouse model using high-dose, restricted-field irradiation to the left lung. Flow cytometry and cytokine profiling analysis of innate lymphoid cells (ILC) reveals a radiation-induced shift from lung-resident type 2 ILCs (ILC2) toward pro-inflammatory type 1 ILCs (ILC1). Single-cell RNA-sequencing analysis of mouse lung ILC populations after radiation suggests that type I interferon (IFN) promotes radiation-induced ILC2-to-ILC1 plasticity. In vitro, IFN-β stimulation of mouse ILC2s leads to increased expression of the ILC1 markers T-bet and IFN-γ, while IFN-β stimulation of human peripheral blood mononuclear cells increases the ILC1-to-ILC2 ratio. In vivo, inhibition of type I IFN signaling attenuates lung damage after irradiation in our RILI model. Thus, our findings indicate that radiation-induced type I IFN induces ILC2-to-ILC1 plasticity to contribute to RILI pathogenesis, and suggest that targeting type I IFN signaling may be a therapeutic strategy to mitigate radiation-induced lung injury.

papers.title: Epithelial NF-κB shapes protective Treg cell responses to restrain intestinal inflammation.
papers.authors: Barleben L, Schneegans AJ, Uyar B, Bruneau A, Vasileva G, Flohr F, Kabrani E, Vasilakis T, Hammann L, Gebert P, Dietrich C, Bochow-Fitzner B, Arnold A, Sai S, Gröne F, Sander M, Conrad T, Gérard A, Piseddu I, Anz D, Jochum C, Akalin A, Hammerich L, Klose CSN, Tacke F, Di Virgilio M, Kolesnichenko M.
papers.abstract: Inflammation resolution depends on coordinated communication between tissue compartments, yet how the intestinal epithelium shapes its immune microenvironment remains poorly understood. Here, using colonic biopsies from patients with ulcerative colitis (UC) and mouse models enabling tissue-wide visualization of NF-κB activity, we combine single-cell RNA sequencing and secretome analysis to define epithelial communication during colitis. We show that, paradoxically, the NF-κB-driven pro-inflammatory secretome of intestinal epithelial cells (IECs) is essential for recovery and prevents unrestrained inflammation. Mechanistically, epithelial NF-κB promotes CCL22-dependent regulatory T cell (Treg cell) recruitment and promotes a tolerogenic, pro-repair cell state, accompanied by induction of the lipid-metabolism-associated GDPD3 and CCR4. In UC, epithelial NF-κB is not uniformly activated but instead induces a selective pro-inflammatory transcriptional program while repressing targets regulating T cell recruitment. Thus, we identify dynamic epithelial-immune communication and demonstrate a protective IEC NF-κB-Treg cell axis important for resolution of intestinal inflammation.

papers.title: Blocking IL-6 trans-signaling mitigates benzalkonium chloride-induced inflammation, oxidative imbalance, ER stress, and barrier disruption in human corneal epithelial cells.
papers.authors: Lax K, Glass J, Aliste A, Sharma A, Sharma S.
papers.abstract: Background Benzalkonium chloride (BAC), a commonly used preservative in ophthalmic formulations, elicits a pro-inflammatory cytokine response and cytotoxic effects in corneal epithelial cells, contributing to ocular surface injuries associated with dry eye disease (DED). Interleukin-6 (IL-6) trans-signaling is a well-established pro-inflammatory pathway that contributes to endothelial and epithelial barrier dysfunction. Thus, this study investigated whether targeted inhibition of IL-6 trans-signaling with sgp130Fc could attenuate BAC-induced cytotoxic injury in corneal epithelial cells. Methods Human telomerase-immortalized corneal epithelial (hTCEpi) cells were exposed to 0.001% BAC for 30 min in the presence or absence of 10 μg/mL sgp130Fc. Markers of inflammation, oxidative imbalance, endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress, and epithelial barrier disruption were assessed using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay, reverse transcriptase polymerase chain reaction, and western blot analyses. Reactive oxygen species (ROS), antioxidant capacity, and intracellular calcium flux were quantified using colorimetric, fluorescence-based, and luminescence-based assays. Epithelial barrier function was assessed using electric cell-substrate impedance sensing. Statistical analyses were performed using one-way analysis of variance followed by Tukey's or Holm-Šídák multiple-comparison tests, with P Results BAC exposure activated IL-6 trans-signaling as indicated by an increased sIL-6R/sgp130 ratio, reduced mIL-6R levels, and unchanged gp130 levels. BAC also increased secreted IL6 levels, IL6RA expression, and downstream inflammatory mediators MCP1 and ICAM1, all of which were attenuated by sgp130Fc. BAC-induced oxidative imbalance was characterized by increased ROS and hydrogen peroxide production, reduced antioxidant enzymes, and diminished total antioxidant capacity, whereas sgp130Fc mitigated these effects. In addition, BAC increased intracellular calcium levels and ER stress markers, including HSP72, BiP, PERK, and Ero1α, and impaired epithelial barrier function as observed by reduced trans-epithelial electrical resistance and decreased β-catenin, occludin, and claudin-1 levels. sgp130Fc mitigated increases in intracellular calcium, partially alleviated ER stress responses, and preserved epithelial barrier integrity and junctional protein levels. Conclusions These findings indicate that IL-6 trans-signaling contributes to BAC-induced corneal epithelial injury, suggesting that targeting this pathway may have therapeutic potential for DED and related ocular surface inflammatory disorders.

papers.title: A microbiome-bile acid axis mediates protection from chronic liver disease in females.
papers.authors: Li M, Kuang J, Chen T, Ding K, Chen Y, Jiao F, Li Y, Luo P, Xia L, Zhang H, Wang J, Zheng D, Zhao M, Sun T, Chao X, Guo Y, Zhu M, Sun Y, Xia X, Ge K, Qu C, Yao C, Xie G, Zhou K, Louca P, Menni C, Zhao A, Guo Q, Wan X, Zhang L, Ji G, Zhou J, Hu C, Jia W, Zheng X, Jia W.
papers.abstract: Sex-based differences in chronic liver disease (CLD) incidence and progression are well documented, yet the mechanistic basis of this sexual disparity remains elusive. Here, leveraging a large-scale metabolomics database comprising 9,254 individuals, we identify the endogenous bile acid, isoursodeoxycholic acid (isoUDCA), as a candidate mediator of female-associated hepatoprotection. We trace the origin of isoUDCA to a bacterial consortium, which is selectively enriched by estrogen through shaping a specialized intestinal microenvironment. Mechanistically, isoUDCA promotes the nuclear accumulation of SREBP2. This upregulates the intracellular transporter STARD4 and its functionally coupled downstream enzyme CYP7B1, thereby facilitating intracellular cholesterol handling and metabolic conversion. Collectively, our findings support a microbiome-bile acid-liver axis that may contribute to sex differences in CLD susceptibility and support further evaluation of isoUDCA as a potential therapeutic intervention.

papers.title: The pyrin inflammasome senses OCTN2-mediated uptake of extracellular ʟ-carnitine from muscle injury or ingestion.
papers.authors: Elliott EI, Yoshida TM, Nakandakari SCBR, Pope S, Zhang C, Nottoli T, Chae JJ, Kastner DL, Flavell RA, Dixit VD, Rathinam VA, Sutterwala FS, Wang A.
papers.abstract: Red-meat-containing diets are epidemiologically associated with diseases of chronic inflammation, while diets that restrict red meat improve health. Yet, it is uncertain how red meat incites inflammation. Here, we discover that ʟ-carnitine, an amino acid highly concentrated in skeletal muscle myocytes, drives inflammasome activation in lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-challenged mice and LPS-primed murine and human macrophages. We find that extracellular ʟ-carnitine represses mevalonate synthesis, thereby triggering activation of the pyrin inflammasome, downstream of cellular import by the high-affinity ʟ-carnitine transporter OCTN2. We find that the inflammatory response to skeletal muscle injury also requires pyrin and OCTN2. Thus, in summary, we identify macrophages as sentinels of exogenous and endogenous extracellular ʟ-carnitine that serve as a proxy for skeletal myocyte damage, and we open the field to examine the mechanistic basis for how excess dietary intake of carnitine-rich food drives inflammatory disease.

papers.title: Frequency encoding regulates cell type composition in the small intestine
papers.zh: 信号振荡频率决定小肠上皮细胞类型构成
papers.authors: Weterings SDC, Eto H, et al.
papers.finding: 通过内源性 Hes1 荧光报告及微流控类器官干预，研究发现 Notch/Hes1 振荡的频率可调控小肠吸收性与分泌性细胞的组成比例。
papers.why: 提示信号传递不只有‘强弱’差异，还可能通过时间频率编码细胞命运，对再生医学和类器官培养具有方法学价值。
papers.problem: 已知 Notch/Wnt 影响肠道谱系，但不清楚动态信号如何精确调控细胞类型组成。
papers.innovation: 将体内动态报告、时空频率测量和可编程微流控扰动联用，直接测试‘振荡频率作为信息’的假说。
papers.limitations: 类器官干预与肠道真实生理环境并不完全等同；需要在疾病、衰老和人源体系进一步确认。
papers.next: 研究炎症、肠道损伤或干细胞衰老状态下频率编码是否改变，以及能否用于定向生成上皮细胞谱系。

papers.title: Cytopathology and Prognostic Accuracy of 15-GEP/PRAME: The Collaborative Ocular Oncology Group Study 2
papers.zh: 细胞病理学能否改善葡萄膜黑色素瘤 15-GEP/PRAME 预后预测？
papers.authors: Lane AM, Schefler AC, Correa ZM, et al.
papers.finding: 多中心队列研究评估在 15 基因表达谱与 PRAME 风险分层之外，确认性细胞病理结果是否影响葡萄膜黑色素瘤转移风险预测准确性。具体效应量需结合论文结果核对。
papers.why: 葡萄膜黑色素瘤的转移风险判定关系到随访密度、影像监测和患者咨询，是典型分子诊断临床转化问题。
papers.problem: 在已使用 GEP/PRAME 的条件下，传统细胞病理检查是否还能带来额外的预后价值。
papers.innovation: 结合多中心随访资料验证分子标志物与细胞病理学信息的互补性，直接针对临床工作流程。
papers.limitations: 当前演示仅核验研究目的与设计，未据全文分析具体效应值或最终结论，不能据此声称预后准确性提高。
papers.next: 核对原文完整统计结果后评估增量判别能力、校准度及决策曲线，并进行外部人群验证。

papers.title: Variables Associated With Faricimab Treatment Durability in Neovascular Age-Related Macular Degeneration: A Post Hoc Analysis of the TENAYA and LUCERNE Trials
papers.zh: 哪些因素提示法瑞西单抗在新生血管性 AMD 中具有更长维持疗效？
papers.authors: Tan CS, Bakall B, Koh AHC, et al.
papers.finding: TENAYA/LUCERNE 试验事后分析发现，较低基线视网膜中央厚度和 PED 最大厚度，以及早期液体消退，与较长的法瑞西单抗给药间隔相关。
papers.why: 对高频就诊的 nAMD 患者而言，疗效持续时间直接影响注射负担、依从性和长期管理。
papers.problem: 如何在治疗早期识别更可能延长注射间隔的患者。
papers.innovation: 结合随机试验影像特征与早期解剖反应，寻找可能提示延长给药间隔的特征。
papers.limitations: 属于事后探索分析，部分 P 值未经多重比较校正；不能将相关性解释为稳定预测因子，且不能直接外推至其他药物。
papers.next: 前瞻性评估超过 16 周的个体化方案，并在真实世界研究中验证影像学预测模型。

papers.title: Comprehensive benchmarking of somatic mutation detection by the SMaHT Network
papers.zh: SMaHT 联盟系统评估体细胞突变检测技术与分析流程
papers.authors: Somatic Mosaicism across Human Tissues (SMaHT) Network
papers.finding: 联盟对短读长、长读长、双链及单细胞测序策略进行基准比较，显示供体特异性或泛基因组推断的二倍体组装可改善困难区域突变检出。
papers.why: 体细胞嵌合突变与衰老、癌症和非肿瘤性疾病相关，技术误差会直接影响临床与机制研究的可靠性。
papers.problem: 缺少统一、可复用的基准来比较不同测序与生信方案对低频体细胞突变的检出能力。
papers.innovation: 联合超深度短读长、长读长、六类双链测序及单细胞测序，强调跨技术互补并形成社区参考资源。
papers.limitations: 基准实验涉及九个分析样本；真实临床样本、低频变异和不同组织的表现仍需进一步外部验证。
papers.next: 在不同年龄、组织和疾病队列中开展独立复测，建立开放的跨平台基准流程并评估临床可迁移性。

papers.title: SpatialZoomer: multi-scale feature analysis of spatial transcriptomics
papers.zh: SpatialZoomer：空间转录组多尺度特征解析方法
papers.authors: Li X, Fan Y, Han Y, et al.
papers.abstract: A spectral graph-based spatial transcriptomics method uses low-pass filtering to extract molecular patterns at single-cell, niche and tissue-domain scales and identifies characteristic scales. Applied to Alzheimer disease progression and cancer microenvironments, it reports strong performance with relatively efficient computing.
papers.finding: 作者提出基于谱图低通滤波的 SpatialZoomer，在单细胞、细胞生态位和组织区域三个尺度提取空间分子特征，并在阿尔茨海默病和肿瘤微环境数据中展示了不同尺度的生物学信号。
papers.why: 单一空间尺度可能掩盖细胞间相互作用及组织结构。该方法强调空间尺度选择本身会改变识别到的细胞状态和疾病特征。
papers.problem: 空间转录组通常在固定分辨率下分析，难以系统比较不同组织尺度上的表达特征，也不易自动确定具有生物学意义的尺度。
papers.innovation: 将谱图滤波用于跨尺度特征提取，并通过跨尺度相似性图选择关键分辨率；论文同时讨论计算效率，并提供实现代码。
papers.limitations: 摘要与网页结果不足以完整判断在低测序深度、不同空间平台及复杂批次效应下的鲁棒性；关键性能差异、参数敏感性和外部验证仍需阅读全文及补充材料。
papers.next: 可进一步评估其在角膜新生血管、睑板腺或干眼眼表空间组学数据中的细胞生态位解析能力，并与细胞互作分析和病理空间标注联合验证。

papers.title: A microexon regulatory code reveals autism-linked genetic variation
papers.zh: 微外显子调控密码揭示与孤独症相关的遗传变异
papers.authors: Parada GE, Bretschneider H, et al.
papers.finding: 研究整合脑组织转录组及单核数据，扩展神经元微外显子图谱，并通过机器学习建立剪接调控序列模型，识别可能改变剪接的孤独症相关稀有变异。
papers.why: 将非编码调控变异与神经元特异性剪接连接，为解释部分既往难以定位功能的遗传风险提供新路径。
papers.problem: 微外显子注释不全，且难以系统预测非编码变异对神经元可变剪接的影响。
papers.innovation: 把大规模微外显子发现、神经元亚型差异与可解释的序列调控建模串联，形成可用于遗传变异优先级排序的框架。
papers.limitations: 变异影响多由模型预测和队列关联支持，不能直接等同于致病因果；细胞类型及功能实验仍需扩大验证。
papers.next: 结合患者来源 iPSC 神经元、长读长转录组及 CRISPR 碱基编辑，逐一验证候选变异对剪接和神经元表型的影响。

papers.title: Divergent genomic evolution in astrocytomas and oligodendrogliomas
papers.zh: 星形细胞瘤与少突胶质细胞瘤的基因组演化路径不同
papers.authors: Chowdhury T, Tesileanu CMS, et al.
papers.finding: 利用 GLASS 联盟 183 名 IDH 突变型胶质瘤患者纵向样本，发现星形细胞瘤更常累积拷贝数异常和染色体不稳定特征，而少突胶质细胞瘤倾向获得新驱动突变。
papers.why: 不同病理亚型的耐药及复发途径并不相同，或有助于设计个体化动态监测策略。
papers.problem: 胶质瘤如何在治疗与时间推移下发生遗传演化，以及不同亚型是否沿同一路径进展，仍存在缺口。
papers.innovation: 对同一患者多时间点全基因组/外显子组序列进行比较，分析不同肿瘤类型的演化差异。
papers.limitations: 队列以具备纵向手术标本的病例为主，存在样本选择与治疗异质性；分子轨迹不直接证明特定药物有效。
papers.next: 整合单细胞、空间组学和液体活检，追踪治疗压力下亚克隆的时间变化并验证预测性标志物。

papers.title: Computational design of metalloproteases
papers.zh: 利用计算蛋白设计构建可编程金属蛋白酶
papers.authors: Chen A, Wu K, Choi H, et al.
papers.finding: 使用 RFdiffusion 设计具有锌活性中心的蛋白酶；135 种设计中约 36% 可在目标位点切割肽链，并演示对 TDP-43、Aβ 等相关蛋白的选择性切割。
papers.why: 从蛋白结构生成跨越到高活性催化功能设计，是 AI 驱动分子工具研发的重要进展。
papers.problem: 从头设计能够高效、位点选择性切割稳定酰胺键的酶长期具有挑战。
papers.innovation: 联合结构生成、活性位点预组织优化与实验筛选；并以设计蛋白酶激活受控细胞因子，展示可编程生物调控。
papers.limitations: 主要处于生化和实验系统验证阶段，底物谱、脱靶切割、体内递送和免疫原性尚待系统评价。
papers.next: 扩展蛋白质组脱靶谱检测和体内功能评价，探索疾病靶向降解或局部激活型生物疗法。

papers.title: Mapping transcriptional responses to cellular perturbations with RNA fingerprinting
papers.zh: RNA 指纹将单细胞表达状态映射到扰动机制
papers.authors: Grabski IN, Lee J, Blair JD, et al.
papers.finding: 提出 RNA fingerprinting 方法，将新实验中的单细胞转录状态与遗传/化学扰动参考字典匹配，可解析 p53 调控、药物作用与感染相关免疫异质性。
papers.why: 单细胞描述性图谱非常丰富，而将未知细胞状态转化为可检验的扰动机制仍有明显缺口。
papers.problem: 如何把观察性单细胞数据与已有因果扰动实验连通，并进行概率化机制归因。
papers.innovation: 构建统计指纹表示并支持基因组规模、组合扰动与跨实验查询，形成可复用的机制检索方法。
papers.limitations: 表现依赖参考扰动字典覆盖范围；相关性匹配不自动等价于对新组织背景的因果证明。
papers.next: 结合空间转录组、CRISPR 验证及跨平台批次效应评估，建立更广泛的扰动参考图库。
